title: bridelia micrantha var. ferruginea
intro: Bridelia micrantha var. ferruginea, commonly known as the "Ironwood" plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various ailments such as fever, inflammation, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bridelia micrantha var. ferruginea include antiseptic, antiviral, and antifungal activities, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
